posts.text: Minnesota farmers don't just feed our state — they power our economy. That's why I co-sponsored the bipartisan American Food Supply Chain Resiliency Act. It creates regional hubs to give small and mid-sized farms business support and new buyers.
posts.summary: Backs bipartisan support for small and mid-sized farm resilience

posts.text:
Every Minnesotan deserves a path to a good-paying job.

As Governor, I will:

📚 Improve reading and math achievement
🔨 Add 10,000 new apprenticeships
🩺 Expand career pathways in health care, teaching, public safety, and the trades
🎓 Make it easier to earn a credential that leads to a career

Talent is everywhere. Opportunity should be too.
posts.summary: Proposes expanded job training and career pathways for Minnesotans

posts.text: Thanks to International Falls Mayor Drake Dill and the team at Rainy Lake Medical Center for the visit and discussion. I-Falls is a wonderful place and it’s also many miles from other medical facilities. That’s why it’s so important that they continue to update their local hospital, clinics and pharmacy. It was great to hear about the work they're doing to provide quality care in northern Minnesota.
